text.p: Following are some of the main
stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified
these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
** For summary of the FINANCIAL TIMES, click on [PRESS/FT]
** For summary of the WALL STREET JOURNAL, click on [PRESS/WSJ]
HET FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Philips to raise over one billion guilders from
sale of two pct stake in Taiwan chip maker TSMC . (p1)
- Consumer confidence in the Netherlands at all-time high.
- Information technology group Baan content with
tax reduction deal struck with Dutch finance ministry. (p3)
- Value of both imports and exports jumped by 18 pct in
April compared to same period of last year. (p4)
- The legal profession is gearing up for millenium bug
liability claims. (p4)
DE VOLKSKRANT
- Chief of Philips subsidiary Pie Medical suspected
of insider trading. (p1)
- Bankruptcies in the Netherlands grew six pct to 2,905 in
the first half of 1997, according to Dun & Bradstreet. (p2)
- Dutch economic growth will outpace that of other EU
countries over next five years, says Dutch research bureau. (p2)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Union says Dutch Rail NS is neglecting safety in order to
meet strong competition. (p6)
TROUW
- Health ministry calls on toy industry to stop producing
toys containing the plastic PVC. (p3)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Paper sector sees slight improvement in selling prices.
